tool_input.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const html=fs.readFileSync('game.html','utf8');const m=html.match(/<script>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/);fs.writeFileSync('/tmp/game_script.js', m[1]);" && node --check /tmp/game_script.js && echo SYNTAX_OK

python3 -c "
import re
html = open('game.html').read()
m = re.search(r'<script>([\s\S]*?)</script>', html)
open('/tmp/game_script.js','w').write(m.group(1))
print('extracted', len(m.group(1)))
"
